key_findings.finding: Canonical Project Workspace and legacy operational Project are different identity spaces. Existing Contract, PO, RFQ and FBS tables still reference projects.id; canonical creation intentionally creates no legacy Project. No automatic Workspace-id to projects.id equivalence is demonstrated.
key_findings.future_action: Wave O1 must specify and validate a tenant-scoped explicit canonical Workspace reference/projection adapter for reusable legacy operational records, including collision, missing mapping, access and status tests. Do not create another Project master or silently equate IDs. Schema changes require future approved increment.

key_findings.finding: Partners, Vendors, Commitments and Procurement menus contain reserved views. ContractsView and dashboard display existing operational data, but contracts is included in EMPTY_SUBMODULE_VIEWS. Route/menu names are not evidence of a completed business lifecycle.
key_findings.future_action: Keep production navigation unchanged now. Future navigation must route sourcing and contract administration to single reused authorities; remove redundant menu access only through managed deprecation and usage checks.

key_findings.finding: Current commitment aggregation sums Contract.value and all PO.committed_amount, including linked contract POs. Executed aggregation sums certificates and warehouse receipts. Available funding subtracts both committed and executed. There is no demonstrated call-off/included-value exclusion, reservation liquidation or common economic-origin deduplication in the inspected paths. This is a design risk, not a claim of duplicated production amounts.
key_findings.future_action: Before operational rollout define additive versus included/call-off PO semantics, open-commitment netting, certificate/receipt economic-event keys and reversal rules. One contractual commitment owner publishes immutable references to Cost; Cost must not add allocation lines or funding coverage as new obligations.

key_findings.finding: Post-FID distinguishes activation blockers from commitment-only conditions; existing legacy Contract/PO write paths enforce legacy membership, contract permission and FBS availability but do not invoke the canonical Post-FID condition authority. Activation alone must not be interpreted as permission to commit.
key_findings.future_action: Future operational commitment command preconditions must evaluate canonical workspace, current authorization scope and unresolved commitment conditions through the existing authority. Do not copy or resolve strategic conditions locally.

recommended_boundaries.procurement: Domain for procurement plans/packages, requisitions, RFQ/RFP, bids, evaluation and award recommendation. A recommendation is not an award/contract and never creates a commitment by itself.
recommended_boundaries.contract_administration_commitments: Separate cohesive operational domain, closely integrated with Procurement. Own legal Contract, PO, future subcontract, original/current obligation, SOV, contractual notices, approved contractual variations and closure. Expose one commitment authority, not a parallel Commitment ledger owner in Cost.
recommended_boundaries.cost: Consume contract/PO commitment references and certified operational cost evidence; own cost coding, approved control budget, accrual/forecast/period-control policy and reporting without mutating legal contracts, strategic funding, FID or historical snapshots.
recommended_boundaries.shared_parties: Future tenant/enterprise-scoped party master with role classifications for vendor, client, joint-venture partner and counterparty. A bidder/vendor label in an operational record is not yet a normalized master. Strategic legal-entity references remain upstream and are linked, not duplicated.
recommended_boundaries.strategic: Commercial strategy packages are concepts; Funding owns capital coverage, FIN owns economic/financial modeling, FID owns investment authorization and Post-FID owns execution eligibility/conditions. None is sourcing or payment execution.
recommended_boundaries.accounting_treasury: Future external invoice/payment/posting interface, not implemented here. Existing certificates are operational certification evidence, not proof of bank payment/accounting settlement.
recommended_boundaries.authority_rule: One owner per legal obligation and economic event; cross-domain references/snapshots only. No new Procurement Manager or duplicate PO/commitment tables/services are introduced in this increment.

capabilities.name: Contract notices / communications

capabilities.name: Payment certificates / retention / warehouse receipts

capabilities.name: Subcontract / Change Order / contract closeout lifecycle
capabilities.current_state: contract_type free text and existing status/closeout controls are primitives only. Reserved changes/payments screens do not establish a separately governed subcontract or contractual change order workflow.

capabilities.name: Strategic Commercial & Contracting Strategy
capabilities.current_state: Canonical Workspace-linked immutable completed strategy versions/readiness, configured ADMIN/USER permissions and governed provider. Packages are explicitly commercial concepts, not procurement transactions.
capabilities.future_owner: Strategic commercial authority; Procurement references completed strategy version/hash and elaborates operational sourcing plan. Any strategic deviation requires explicit governed review, not local overwrite.

capabilities.future_owner: Strategic Funding; downstream consumes assignment restrictions/coverage and frozen authorization references. No automatic copying to operational budget, available FBS, PO or cash actuals.

capabilities.future_owner: Operational Cost owns approved control funding mapping and derived balance; strategic funding remains referenced source/constraint. Reconcile original/current commitment, outstanding reservation and cost actuals before wider rollout.

capabilities.name: Invoice / payment / Accounting and Treasury execution
capabilities.current_state: Out of this increment; PO/SC payment labels are reserved and certificates are not payments. No new payment/accounting function authorized.
capabilities.future_owner: External Accounting/Treasury integration with explicit references, reconciliation and posting/settlement statuses. Retain operational certificates as evidence only.

Canonical activation is separate explicit command with If-Match and independent actor.
governance_model_handoff.operational_entry: Canonical PROJECT Workspace active, lifecycle activation certificate/reference, current applicable authorization/condition policy and scoped access. Preserve FID/authorization version/hash. A technical UAT signoff-pending system is not production/business authorization.

governance_model_handoff.current_authority: Same canonical project-creation and initialization/activation services. Contract source requires client, contract_number, contractual_scope; mobilization_authorized or notice_to_proceed_date supplies route authorization. Full Capital Owner FEL/FID requirements are false by default, unless configured policy legitimately applies them.
governance_model_handoff.operational_entry: Active canonical Project Workspace with source contract authorization and template/access/current policy. Client scope/schedule/revenue contract context are upstream, not automatically spend commitments or Capital Owner investment budget.

governance_model_handoff.current_authority: Same canonical creation/lifecycle services. Source requires authorization_reference and sponsor; authorization_approved drives activation authorization. Full Capital Owner investment sequence is not a default prerequisite.
governance_model_handoff.operational_entry: Active canonical Project Workspace with internal approval reference/scope and applicable control template/access. Tailored execution process, not forced external procurement or full FID.
